ai-telefonsvarer-eller-telefonpasning.lead: When you can't take the call yourself, there are three options: an ordinary answering machine, a call answering service staffed by people, or an AI answering machine. Here are the differences.
points: Answering machine: cheap, but callers often hang up
Call answering service: a person answers, but usually only during business hours
AI answering machine: answers around the clock and can book appointments
Choose based on call volume, opening hours and needs

body.text: Cheap and simple, but many callers hang up instead of leaving a message – and call a competitor. You have to listen through the messages yourself and call back without knowing what the matter is about.

A person answers the phone in your name and takes a message. It feels personal, but it is usually billed per call or per month, and many services are only open during normal working hours. The receptionist rarely knows your services and prices in detail.

talks to the caller in your customers' language around the clock, answers from your own approved knowledge and can book appointments and send SMS confirmations. You get a written summary of every conversation instead of a voice message.

body.text: On the other hand, it isn't a person – it says so honestly and passes on matters it can't answer to you.

faq: Can an AI answering machine replace a call answering service?
For most routine enquiries, yes: it answers, clarifies the need and books. Complex matters are passed on to you.
Is an AI answering machine available at night?
Yes, Dialogbot answers the phone around the clock.
Which is cheaper: a call answering service or Dialogbot?

A call answering service is usually billed per call or per month. Dialogbot is one subscription at {pMonthly} per month excl. VAT, with 300 minutes of incoming calls and no price per enquiry. See also /viden/dialogbot-vs-vocalis.
Can I keep my number?
Yes. You forward your number to Dialogbot when you are busy or closed.

meta.ogTitle: How to forward your phone | Dialogbot

viderestil-telefonen.title: How to forward your phone when you're busy
viderestil-telefonen.lead: With call forwarding, calls go on to another number – e.g. your AI receptionist – when you can't take them yourself. Here are the standard codes you dial on your mobile.
points: When busy: **67*number#
On no answer: **61*number#
When the phone is off: **62*number#
Always: **21*number#
Turn off all forwarding: ##002#

body.text: The codes are standard on the mobile network and work with most Danish carriers. Enter the number with +45 in front, and press call after the code.

items: – some carriers let you set the number of seconds:

items.b: When the phone is off or has no coverage:

body.text: If a code doesn't work, or you have a landline or IP phone system, turn on forwarding in your carrier's app or self-service portal, or ask your carrier.

parts: Most businesses use
. That way you answer the phone yourself when you can, and all other calls go to your AI receptionist instead of the answering machine.

faq: Does call forwarding cost anything?
It depends on your subscription with your carrier. Check the price of forwarded calls with your carrier.
How do I check whether forwarding is on?
Dial e.g. *#67# or *#61# and press call – the phone then shows the status.
Can I keep my own number?
Yes. Customers still call your number; calls are only forwarded when you don't answer yourself.
